build_BackboneNet: build a BackboneNet module that extracts image features using a ResNet backbone network
build_PoseNet: build a PoseNet module that predicts 3D joint heatmaps, root depth, and hand type from image features

refactor_BackboneNet_init_weights: refactor the BackboneNet init_weights method to initialize ResNet backbone weights for training
